mechanism: Ranitidine inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, reducing haloperidol metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations, while both agents have anticholinergic properties that may be additive.
action: Monitor for increased haloperidol side effects including extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, and anticholinergic effects; consider haloperidol dose reduction or alternative H2-blocker if clinically feasible.
